status: registered before collection and one-time independent scoring
scope: Independent offline confirmation of the fixed depth-only gate for the three-marker cutter TCP proxy on the non-anatomical simulation sheet. Not clinical validation, direct blade visibility proof, a stop permit, or controller integration. No M5 change.

cohort.selection: Starting at 412 (one past the separately reserved v1 indices), examine nonoverlapping blocks of 40 consecutive indices, through the last block starting below 10000. Lock the first block whose pre-capture sampled scenarios contain >=16 occlusion_transient episodes and >=5 of each other registered scenario. No images, labels, execution outcomes or estimated gate results in selection. This cohort is occlusion-enriched, not an estimate of natural prevalence.
cohort.acquisition: Use unchanged scripts/learn/collect.py and registered scene, base configuration and sampler. Truth-controlled collection only. Dedicated simulator profiles on ports 24620-24623; actual 640x480 ECM only (--no-aux). Preserve all DONE and FSM FAILED episodes. No substitutions or reruns; any missing episode, refusal, infrastructure error, missing frame, corruption or cleanup failure makes confirmation incomplete.

readers: Unchanged ray-refined three-marker baseline and exactly the fixed depth rule from the development protocol. The gate only suppresses coordinates. It uses a valid in-image marker estimate, complete finite 9x9 depth patch, and the central 3x3 all nearer than marker TCP z by strictly more than 3 mm. No learned gate, label, pose, state, history or timing in any reader.

scoring.labels: Same virtual TCP label policy, clean-depth evidence and timing strata as learned_tip_v1. Labels only in scorer; same labels for clean and registered 0.5 mm noise. Same seeded draw for both readers.
scoring.coverage: Require at least four distinct independent episodes with a depth_blocked exposure, at least one supported positive exposure per registered scenario, and at least one blocked exposure with an actual marker-only output per depth stream to exercise suppression. Otherwise incomplete, regardless of point estimates.
scoring.gates: Per depth stream fixed rule: supported-positive coverage >=90%, median accepted-positive 3D error <0.5 mm, fraction of accepted positives with 3D error >2 mm <5%, and zero accepted explicit negatives. No change to the development cutoffs. Report baseline, fixed gate, paired retained/suppressed counts and episode bootstrap intervals. One scoring attempt; no rerun, tuning, or automatic use in control.
